title: FlagEnvironment
description: The configuration of a feature flag for a specific environment.

true.description: Whether the flag is currently enabled in this environment.

archived.description: Whether the flag is archived in this environment.

salt.description: The salt used for percentage rollout hashing.

lastModified.description: Unix epoch timestamp of the last modification.

version.description: The version number of this flag configuration.

targets.description: Individual context targets for each variation.

rules.description: Targeting rules that determine which variation to serve.

fallthrough.description: The default rule applied when no other rules match.

offVariation.description: The variation index to serve when the flag is off.
